analysis.one_line_summary: Step-by-step thermal brush tutorial demonstrating how to curl, twist, and set long hair for a salon blowout look at home.
analysis.full_description: A creator sits at a table and presents a step-by-step styling tutorial using the WavyTalk Blowout Boost thermal brush. The video starts with a preview of her voluminous styled hair before breaking down the exact technique: sectioning, curling away from the face, gliding slowly, holding for 5-10 seconds, and twisting out while holding the base to prevent tangling. It shows front fringe styling towards the face, setting with clips, cooling, and shaking out into massive bouncy curls. An 'UP TO 25 % OFF' banner overlay appears across the mid-section of the video.

on_screen_text.text:
Step by step
thermal brush tutorial

Brush out hair
make sure there's no tangles

Glide down slowly
And then roll up half way

Then start twisting away
slowly releasing the hair

Holding the hair at the
base will help with pulling

Make sure there's not too
much hair wrapped in the
curler before twisting

When twisting, hair should be
wrapped just at the top of
the curler to avoid tangling

The twisting helps the curl
cool and hold in place

I like to curl the front
pieces towards the face
to add volume
